_note: Token-aligned counterfactual lines for the CDIM experiment (Mechanistic_paper.md §3). Each entry replaces one bullet line of the named substrate file with a line that has the SAME token count under the Llama-3 and Qwen3 tokenizers (checked 18 Sep 2026) and neutralises or reverses the line's semantics. cdim.py refuses a counterfactual whose token count differs. prompts/ itself is never modified.

substrate.txt.name: cf1
substrate.txt.text: - Perform an activity on an object, without transporting the object from location A to B.

substrate.txt.name: cf2
substrate.txt.text: - All other objectives or goals are relevant for the user.

substrate.txt.name: cf3
substrate.txt.text: - Activities require the object to stay at location A while the user moves to location B.

substrate.txt.name: cf4
substrate.txt.text: - The object is never initially with the user at location A.

substrate.txt.name: cf5
substrate.txt.text: - Moving the user without moving the object does fully satisfy the objective.

substrate.txt.name: cf6
substrate.txt.text: - If the object is a vehicle, the user may leave the object in order to perform the activity at location B.

substrate.txt.name: cf6n
substrate.txt.text: - If the object is a vehicle, the user must inspect the object in order to perform the activity at location B.

substrate.txt.name: cf6s
substrate.txt.text: - If the object is a vehicle, the user must leave the object in order to perform the activity at location B.

substrate_pro.txt.name: p1
substrate_pro.txt.text: - Perform an activity on an object at a starting location.

substrate_pro.txt.name: p2
substrate_pro.txt.text: - The object must be at the starting location for the activity to complete.

substrate_pro.txt.name: p3
substrate_pro.txt.text: - All other objectives or goals are relevant for the user.

substrate_pro.txt.name: p4
substrate_pro.txt.text: - The object is initially with the user at location B.

substrate_pro.txt.name: p5
substrate_pro.txt.text: - The activity is performed at location B (the service location). The object may be absent at location B.

substrate_pro.txt.name: p6
substrate_pro.txt.text: - Vehicles are fully portable. Walking brings a vehicle along. Leaving the object behind fails the objective.

substrate_pro.txt.name: p7
substrate_pro.txt.text: - Books are portable. Driving transports both the user and the book.

substrate_pro.txt.name: p8
substrate_pro.txt.text: - Leaving the object behind meets the objective.

substrate_pro.txt.name: p9
substrate_pro.txt.text: - To transport a vehicle from A to B, the user may leave it.

substrate_pro.txt.name: p9s
substrate_pro.txt.text: - To transport a vehicle from A to B, the user must leave it.
